children.value: Overview
Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
Engagement Details

Our client's platform helps businesses build scalable content creation workflows powered by AI, APIs, and automation. Our customers rely on us to integrate their data, automate complex workflows, and generate high-quality content at scale.
A recently funded $40M Series B platform helping brands stay visible as search shifts from links to AI answers.
It enables marketing teams to see how their brand shows up across AI search, identify high-impact opportunities, and create accurate, on-brand content at scale using AI, automation, and integrated data. Built for quality and control, it helps teams protect brand voice, measure real impact, and win trust with both AI systems and humans in the new discovery era.
This role is not about building the company's core platform but rather about leveraging it to create effective customer solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain custom integrations between client and customer CMSs (WordPress, Contentful, Sanity and others)
Gather customer integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications
Implement API integrations (REST, JSON, XML) with third-party platforms including task management tools
Document integration patterns, create setup guides, and enable customer success through technical enablement
Contribute to building reusable integration frameworks and templates that scale across our customer base
Monitor integration health, implement error handling, and ensure secure data exchanges
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and CX teams to identify common integration needs and inform product roadmap
Benefits:

Equity in a fast-growing startup
Competitive benefits package tailored to your location
Flexible time off policy
Parental Leave
A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!
What’s in it for you
Learn and evolve your skills using the latest and greatest technology tools in a rapidly growing company.
Learn from the best people around you. We constantly challenge the status quo and invent new ways of building a great product.
100% remote. Work anywhere, whether it is remotely in the comfort of your home, in a shared co-working space, in an RV on the beach, or while being a nomad in another country.
Work on challenging problems, innovate, and positively impact many people's lives while having fun doing it.
Required Qualifications
Upper-intermediate to fluent speaking and writing English. Able to have a real-time conversation.
5+ years of full-time hands-on Python experience.
3+ years of full-time hands-on Javascript experience.
3+ years of experience building production software and API integrations
1+ years of full-time hands-on translating business requirements into technical specifications experience.
1+ years of full-time hands-on LLM integration experience.
Proven experience designing and implementing REST APIs and web services
Hands-on experience with modern web development practices and tools
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, especially when debugging complex integration issues
Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer projects simultaneously
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and making pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving environment
Experience gathering technical requirements and translating them into working solutions
Nice to haves
Direct experience building integrations with CMSs (WordPress, Prismic, Contentful, Webflow, etc.)
Familiarity with task management APIs (Asana, Jira, Monday.com, ClickUp)
Knowledge of webhook architectures and event-driven systems
Interest in or experience with generative AI and content marketing workflows
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent demonstrated ability.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.
What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 38+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
What happens if the engagement is completed?
Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.
What are your core values?
Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.
Ownership: we embrace responsibility, taking on challenges, getting them to completion, and enjoying getting things done.
Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.
